identity.title: Pinned Hermes Default SOUL.md Research-Home Compatibility Repair
identity.objective: Repair the AF1 Phase-B HERMES_HOME_CONTROL_PLANE_INVALID defect by admitting SOUL.md in a dedicated controlled research HERMES_HOME only when it is a regular non-symlink file whose raw bytes exactly equal the pinned Hermes v0.21.3 (tag v2026.9.14, commit 345cd2b) stock auto-seeded default: 667 bytes, SHA-256 36c1f5a2e92cd1d018311eaf4c8f1e8886672eae78212e033c681d0e3d5d506f. Every other SOUL.md and every other existing clean-home rule remains fail-closed. Admission verification only; no mutation-to-pass, no policy/schema churn, and no provider, credential, AF1 Attempt-03, H1 #5, Gate C, capital, order or merge authority.

scope.rollback_surface: One private exact-bytes SOUL.md admission verifier and its frozen constants in runner.py plus focused tests and truth docs; no dependency, workflow, policy, argv, managed-config, provider, retry, telemetry, context-protocol, execution, OMS, risk or live-trading change.

api_matrix.reason: The package narrows one existing research-home admission predicate; no public signature changes.

items.before: Any SOUL.md present in the research HERMES_HOME rejected the home, which is structurally incompatible with pinned Hermes v0.21.3 seeding its stock SOUL.md on home initialization.
items.after: An absent SOUL.md or a regular non-symlink SOUL.md whose raw bytes are exactly the pinned 667-byte stock default (SHA-256 36c1f5a2e92cd1d018311eaf4c8f1e8886672eae78212e033c681d0e3d5d506f) is admitted; every other SOUL.md rejects.
items.compatibility_requirement: Signature, return type, every other forbidden name, config.yaml, plugins, skills, safe-home and credential-name-only rules are unchanged; ExternalHermesCliBackend.invoke still rechecks before every spawn.

semantic_fields.reason: Exact-bytes SOUL admission, no broadening, unchanged other rules, credential opacity, per-invoke recheck, frozen pin and non-authority are mandatory deterministic semantics.

items.required_rule: SOUL.md is admitted only when absent or when it is a regular non-symlink non-reparse file whose size is exactly 667 bytes and whose raw-byte SHA-256 is exactly 36c1f5a2e92cd1d018311eaf4c8f1e8886672eae78212e033c681d0e3d5d506f; any stat/open/read error, other size, other digest, symlink or non-regular object rejects.
items.validation_rule: exact stock passes; one-byte, same-size, truncated, extended, custom and symlink SOUL fail closed

items.required_rule: No normalization, legacy-template set, prefix or fuzzy match, alternate encoding, arbitrary allowlist or caller-supplied digest exists; the verifier takes no accepted-digest parameter and never mutates, deletes, rewrites or replaces SOUL.md.
items.validation_rule: verifier signature and module surface expose no broadening hook

items.required_rule: Private constants bind the exception to pinned Hermes v0.21.3 tag v2026.9.14 commit 345cd2b stock DEFAULT_SOUL_MD: byte length 667 and SHA-256 36c1f5a2e92cd1d018311eaf4c8f1e8886672eae78212e033c681d0e3d5d506f; Hermes Agent is not imported.
items.validation_rule: focused test binds both constants to the frozen values

items.required_rule: config.yaml, non-empty plugins/, non-empty skills/, MEMORY.md, USER.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md and .cursorrules still reject, and the safe-home locator rule is unchanged.
items.validation_rule: direct negative tests for each remaining forbidden artifact

items.required_rule: The clean-home checker never opens, parses or emits .env or auth.json; only the non-secret SOUL.md is read.
items.validation_rule: fake sentinel credential values never appear and credential files are never opened by the checker

items.required_rule: ExternalHermesCliBackend.invoke re-runs the clean-home check before every spawn so a SOUL.md mutated after an earlier passing preflight fails before any child process starts.
items.validation_rule: stock passes, mutated SOUL makes a later invoke fail with launch_failed and no spawn

items.required_rule: No provider, model, Firecrawl, Polymarket, OAuth, credential, dependency, workflow, scheduler, strategy, paper, execution, live, AF1 Attempt-03, H1 number five, Gate C, capital, order or merge authority is granted.
items.validation_rule: authority booleans remain as mirrored and tests use only local offline children

identity_derivations.reason: No content-addressed product identity is added; the frozen SOUL digest is a pinned external constant verified by a focused test.

T03 invoke with exact stock SOUL launches the offline inspection child without admission failure
T04 a one-byte modification of the stock SOUL fails closed
T05 a different 667-byte regular file fails closed
T06 truncated, extended, CRLF, BOM and trailing-newline variants fail before hashing can pass
T07 custom persona, legacy scaffold and empty SOUL.md files fail closed
T08 a SOUL.md symlink to exact stock bytes and a SOUL.md directory fail closed
T09 MEMORY USER AGENTS CLAUDE GEMINI and .cursorrules still fail even beside stock SOUL
T10 config.yaml, non-empty plugins and non-empty skills still fail beside stock SOUL
T11 the checker opens only SOUL.md and fake credential sentinels never appear in evidence
T12 stock passes then a mutated SOUL makes the later invoke fail before child spawn
T13 accepted constants equal 667 bytes and the frozen 36c1f5a2 SHA-256 digest
T14 verifier takes only the home path and no legacy normalization or caller digest hook exists
